questions.q_en: Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 20 hrs and 30 hrs respectively but due to a drainage pipe C, the tank gets filled in 60 hrs when all the three pipes are opened simultaneously. Find the time taken by pipes A and C to empty a fully filled tank, when opened together.
questions.solution_en:
Tank filled by A in 1 hr = 1/20

Tank filled by B in 1 hr = 1/30

Let tank leaked by C in 1 hr = 1/x

1/20 + 1/30 - 1/x = 1/60

x = 15

Or pipe C can empty in 15 hours

Now A + C = 1/15 - 1/20

= (4 - 3)/60 = 1/60

= 60 hrs to empty

questions.q_en: In how many ways can 15 differently coloured chairs are attached to a round swing?

Total number of ways = (15 - 1)!/2 = 14!/2 = 7*13!

questions.q_en: A fruit vendor sells apples at ₹220/kg which he bought for ₹200/kg. But by using false weight, he gives only 920 gm of the apples instead of 1 kg while selling. What is the actual percentage profit earned by the seller?
questions.solution_en:
Cost price of 920 gm apples = 200*920/1000 = ₹184

Selling price of 920 gm apples = ₹220/kg

Profit percentage = [(220 - 184)/184]*100 = 19.56%

questions.q_en: A train running at a speed of 54 km/hr crosses another train of double its length running in the opposite direction at a speed of 45 km/hr in 36 seconds. Find the length of the longer train.
questions.solution_en:
Let the length of train be X.

Length of another train be 2X.

3X/{(54 + 45) X (5/18)} = 36

3X/{99 X (5/18)} = 36

X = 330 meters

Therefore, Length of longer train = 2 X 330 = 660 meters

questions.q_en: The 10th term of a geometric series is 8 times the 7th term of the series. If 5th term of the series is 80, then what is the 8th term of the series?
questions.solution_en:
The 10th term of a geometric series is 8 times the 7th term of the series.

=> ar9 = 8 * ar6

=> r3 = 8

=> r = 2

5th term of the series is 80.

=> ar4 = 80

=> a * 24 = 80

=> a = 80/16

=> a = 5

Hence, 8th term of the series = 5 * 27 = 640

LCM of 4, 7 and 12 = 84

99999 when divided by 84 leaves 39 as remainder

Required number = 99999 - 39 = 99960

questions.q_en: Find the lateral surface area of a prism with equilateral triangular base, if volume and area of base of prism are 60√3 cm3 and 4√3 cm2 respectively.
questions.solution_en:
Volume of prism = Height * Base area

60√3 = Height * 4√3

Height = 15 cm

Let side of base of prism = 'a' cm

√3/4 * a2 = 4√3

a2 = 16

a = 4

Perimeter of base of prism = 3 * 4 = 12 cm

Lateral surface area of prism = Height * Perimeter of base

= 15 * 12

= 180 cm2

questions.q_en: Ritika alone can paint (4/5)th part of a house in 48 hours while Ravi can paint 1/3rd part of the house in 25 hours. If Ravi start painting the house and on every third hour Ritika joined him, then the house will be painted in -
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by Ritika alone to paint = 48 * 5/4 = 60 hours

Time taken by Ravi alone to paint = 25 * 3/1 = 75 hours

Since, Ravi start painting the house and on every third hour Ritika joined him. Then,

First two hours work done by Ravi alone = 2/75

Third hour's work done by Ravi and Ritika together = 1/75 + 1/60 = 3/100

Then, first 3 hours work done = 2/75 + 3/100 = 17/300

Therefore, part of work done in (3 * 17 = 51) hours = 17 * 17/300 = 289/300

Remaining work = 1 - 289/300 = 11/300

Now, part of work done by Ravi in next two hours (i.e., 52nd and 53rd hour) = 2/75

Then, remaining work = 11/300 - 2/75 = 1/100

Now, time taken by Ravi and Ritika together to do remaining work = (1/100) * 100/3 = 1/3 hours = 1/3 * 60 = 20 minutes

Therefore, total time taken = 51 hours + 2 hours + 20 minutes

= 53 hours 20 minutes

questions.q_en: A number X is such that it is the product of three consecutive positive integers and M = N + X, where N is an odd number, then which of the following option will be true for the value of M?
questions.solution_en:
Given that X is the product of three consecutive integers, therefore X will always be an even number.

Now, M = N + X where N is an odd number

We know that,

Even number + odd number = odd number

So, M will be an odd number.

questions.q_en: A man, a woman, and a boy can complete a job in 10, 15, and 20 days respectively. When working together, how many boys must assist one man and one woman to complete the work in 3/5th of a day?
questions.solution_en:
Total work = LCM of 10, 15, and 20 = 60 units

Efficiency of A man = 6 units per day

Efficiency of a woman =4 units per day

Efficiency of a boy = 3 units per day

Let the required number of boys = X

Therefore,

(6 + 4 + 3X) * (3/5) = 60

10 + 3X = 100

3X = 90

X = 30

questions.q_en: The average marks of 60 students in a class are 62. The average marks of boys and girls in that subject are 60 and 65, respectively. The number of boys in the class is:
questions.solution_en:
Let number of boys and girls in the class are 'x' and '60 - x' respectively.

Sum of ages of all the students = 62 * 60 + x * 60 + (60 - x) * 65

3720 = 60x + 3900 - 65x

5x = 180

x = 36

Number of boys in the class = x = 36

questions.q_en: Two pipes X and Y can fill a tank in 14 hours and 21 hours, respectively. Both pipes are opened simultaneously to fill the tank. In how many hours will the empty tank be filled?
questions.solution_en:
Pipe X can fill the tank in 14 hours

Pipe Y can fill the tank in 21 hours

L.C.M of 14 and 21 is 42

Efficiency of X is :- 42/14 = 3

Efficiency of Y is :- 42/21 = 2

When both pipes will open simultaneoulsy, efficiency = (3+2) = 5

So time taken by them to fill tank = 42/5 = 8(2/5)

Option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: The cost price of 31 articles is the same as the selling price of X articles. If the profit is 24%, then the value of X is:
questions.solution_en:
Let the C.P. of 1 article be Rs. 'a'.

C.P of 31 articles = Rs. 31a

S.P of X articles = Rs. 31a

S.P of 1 article = C.P * (100 + Profit)/100 = a * 124/100 = Rs. 1.24a

S.P of X article = X * 1.24a

31a = 1.24a * X

X = 25

questions.q_en: In a ∆MNO, ∠NOM = 45°, ∠OMN = 120° and side ON = 18√6 cm, then the length of side MN of ∆MNO is equal to:
questions.solution_en:
Given, ∠NOM = 45°, and ∠OMN = 120°, and side ON = 18√6 cm

By sine rule,

ON/sin120° = MN/sin45°

=> 18√6/(√3/2) = MN/(1/√2)

=> MN = 36√2 * 1/√2

=> MN = 36 cm
